name: Add a Record to an Attio List
description: Adds a person, company, or other record to an Attio list. Useful for managing sales pipelines, onboarding lists, or any workflow list.

parentObject.description: Object slug the record belongs to (e.g., 'people', 'companies')

parentRecordId.description: UUID of the record to add to the list

entryValues.description: Optional attribute values for the list entry. Map of attribute slug to array of values.

steps.name: Create list entry via Attio API
